data.name:
/bin/sh -c "apply_patch <<'EOF'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: migration/schema.sql
@@
 CREATE TABLE orders (
     id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
     total_amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL,
     tax_amount NUMERIC(12, 2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (total_amount * 0.10) STORED
 );
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_order_status_on_amount_update()
+RETURNS TRIGGER AS "'$$
+BEGIN
+    IF NEW.total_amount > 1000 THEN
+        NEW.status := '"'processed';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+"'$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER set_order_status_on_amount_update
+BEFORE UPDATE OF total_amount ON orders
+FOR EACH ROW
+EXECUTE FUNCTION set_order_status_on_amount_update();
*** End Patch
EOF
cat /home/agent/workspace/migration/schema.sql'
